title: Stronger Security Drives Ransomware Groups to Recruit From Within
summary: Tenable's Satnam Narang tells Dark Reading that hardened external perimeters are driving ransomware syndicates toward insider threat recruitment, citing a recent example from the notorious hacking group, LockBit 2.0.
